objective: Finish the controlled winter system, preserve the unrecovered XC ownership penalty, measure the real visitor funnel, capture existing winter search intent without thin URLs, and then freeze feature work until observed data or a defect justifies reopening it.
fatalPenalties: claiming the live XC source/deployment is recovered without evidence
mutating the unrecovered xcski production application
creating a new indexable winter landing URL that competes with the existing XC or Ice owners
weakening the Michigan Ice safety boundary or turning remote data into a safety rating
turning weather/snow data into an unsupported grooming claim
adding cookies, localStorage, fingerprinting, or personal data to winter funnel measurement
continuing winter feature churn after the final hardening merge without a documented reopen trigger
reopenTriggers: in-season Search Console or first-party behavior data identifies a measured loss

outcomeMetrics.principle: The readiness score is a build gate. Real winter traffic and behavior are the market loss function.
funnel: XC live or Ice regional handoff
